Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary funds statement (p7), whose expense total 326,138 equals the Statement of Activities business-type expenses (p2). Beginning governmental cash is not printed (null); ending cash 1,780,210 and certificates of deposit 83,080 from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4); county treasurer cash 5,826 is a separate asset line. Fund balance roll-forward 1,694,082 + 1,050,735 - 823,201 - 52,500 = 1,869,116 reconciles; business-type 110,920 + 382,363 - 326,138 + 52,500 = 219,645 reconciles. General Fund detail is taken from the more detailed department combining schedule (pp13-14); the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p9) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Law enforcement 6,048 in the General department is public safety (the statement's public safety 28,704 = Fire 22,656 + 6,048). Park 'Debt service' 3,081 = General Fund principal payments (p5). Water and Sewer have no budget schedules, so their detail comes from the proprietary statement fund columns; their expenditure totals are the Statement of Activities expenses (p2).
